rows.resolution_note: Rule C: sentence 2 of p001 defines the authors' own prospective cohort analysis of UK Biobank individual-level data by more than a number of participants (baseline assessments 2006 to 2010, follow-up until September 1, 2023; sentence 3 adds the exclusion of pre-existing dementia, the restriction to participants with diabetes and Olink proteomics); no accession, citation or release of a published UK Biobank GWAS is given, so no dictionary row is identified.
rows.quote: Method This prospective cohort study utilized UK Biobank data, encompassing baseline assessments from 2006 to 2010 and follow‐up until September 1, 2023.
